description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Jermar Jefferson has been signed by the Minnesota Vikings. In a corresponding move, the team released Jordan Mims.
items.impact: Jefferson has been around the league for a while now, mostly as a depth piece. It's likely the same sort of thing here. He will, in all likelihood, not be fantasy relevant.
items.title: Jermar Jefferson signs with Minnesota Vikings

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka limped off the practice field on Wednesday and was examined by trainers. Nothing else is known yet as of writing, but it appears he was on the table for a while.
items.impact: It's possible he suffered a stinger or minor injury, given the fact that other reports say he got off the field on his own power. His status will need to be monitored, as any absence will open the door for Chris Godwin and Ted Hurst to get more looks, and don't forget about Cade Otton.
items.title: Emeka Egbuka limps off practice field Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Steelers rookie OT Max Iheanachor suffered an injury at practice last week and remains without a clear timetable to return.
items.impact: This will be a situation to continue to monitor with the preseason starting this week.
items.title: Max Iheanachor without timetable to return

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers waived/injured Lorenzo Thompson.
items.impact: Thompson will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp once he is cleared.
items.title: Lorenzo Thompson waived by Steelers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers waived WR Colton Dowell.
items.impact: Dowell will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Colton Dowell waived by Steelers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers signed WR Isaiah Winstead.
items.impact: Winstead will compete for a depth role Steelers wide receiver room in training camp.
items.title: Isaiah Winstead signs with Steelers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers signed WR Cornell Powell.
items.impact: Powell will compete for a depth role Steelers wide receiver room in training camp.
items.title: Cornell Powell signs with Steelers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles placed RB Elijah Mitchell on injured reserve.
items.impact: Mitchell is likely to be out for the upcoming season.
items.title: Elijah Mitchell placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles signed DL Tarron Jackson.
items.impact: Jackson will compete for a depth role on the defensive line for the Eagles in training camp.
items.title: Tarron Jackson signs with Eagles

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles signed RB Ja'Quinden Jackson.
items.impact: Jackson will compete for a depth role in the backfield for the Eagles in training camp.
items.title: Ja'Quinden Jackson signs with Eagles

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles signed DL David Blay Jr.
items.impact: Blay will compete for a depth role on the defensive line for the Eagles in training camp.
items.title: David Blay Jr. signs with Eagles

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Browns coach Todd Monken said he's "hopeful" to get DT Mike Hall Jr. back at practice soon.
items.impact: "He got off to such a great start," Monken said. Hall hasn't practiced since August 3.
items.title: Mike Hall Jr. expected to return to practice soon

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Eli Heidenreich told reporters he practiced on Tuesday and expects to play Thursday against the Packers.
items.impact: Heidenreich missed  few practices last week with an injury. He should be good to go on Thursday.
items.title: Eli Heidenreich practices Tuesday, expected to play in preseason opener

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders signed LB Curtis Jacobs.
items.impact: Jacobs spent time in the UFL with the DC Defenders. He will compete for a depth role in the Commanders linebacker room.
items.title: Curtis Jacobs signs with Commanders

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Falcons claimed OG Jaeden Roberts off waivers.
items.impact: The Eagles waived Roberts on Monday. He signed with the Eagles as a college free agent in May.
items.title: Jaeden Roberts claimed off waivers by Falcons

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jets activated EDGE Joseph Ossai from the PUP list.
items.impact: Ossai missed the start of training camp. He has been cleared to return to practice.
items.title: Joseph Ossai activated from PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns placed CB Damarri Mathis on injured reserve.
items.impact: Mathis was carted off with an injury at Browns practice on Tuesday.
items.title: Damarri Mathis placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns signed TE Dae'Quan Wright.
items.impact: Wright signed with the Eagles after going undrafted out of Ole Miss. He'll compete for a depth role in the Browns tight end room.
items.title: Dae'Quan Wright signs with Browns

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Puka Nacua (groin) who left practice on Tuesday, is dealing with some mild soreness in his groin. The team is playing things safe.
items.impact: It doesn't sound like it's anything serious, but of course any injury needs to be monitored as the season approaches. Fantasy managers shouldn't fret too much, Nacua is still an elite pick in fantasy.
items.title: Puka Nacua (groin) dealing with groin soreness

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chargers OT Rashawn Slater is dealing with a flare-up in his knee.
items.impact: Slater missed his fourth straight practice on Tuesday. His status will need to continue to be monitored.
items.title: Rashawn Slater dealing with flare-up in knee

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bears coach Ben Johnson said that Coby Bryant had surgery and will be out 4-6 months.
items.impact: It is a brutal blow for Bryant and Chicago after he signed a three-year, $40 million contract in free agency. He could miss the entire season.
items.title: Coby Bryant undergoes surgery, to miss 4-6 months

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said there will be no limitations on rookie cornerback Jermod McCoy this Thursday.
items.impact: "We expect him to play we expect him to compete and we're excited to see him play," Kubiak said. McCoy fell in the draft in April due to injury concerns from college.
items.title: Jermod McCoy (knee) to play in preseason opener without limitations

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jadarian Price was back in pads at practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Price winds up missing just a few days of practice due to a leg injury. The rookie continues to earn his reps with the first-team during training camp.
items.title: Jadarian Price (leg) back in pads at practice Tuesday

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Nick Bosa is dealing with knee tendinitis and is viewed as week-to-week, according to head coach Kyle Shanahan.
items.impact: Bosa is making his way back from an ACL tear, and the 49ers are likely being cautious with their defensive cornerstone. The 28-year-old should be monitored throughout training camp, as the injury could bleed into the regular season if there are no improvements.
items.title: Nick Bosa (knee) considered week-to-week

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak expects Fernando Mendoza to see "plenty" of playing time in the team's preseason opener on Thursday against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Kubiak made it clear coming into camp that Mendoza is the QB2 behind Kirk Cousins, and the rookie will get a chance to introduce himself to the NFL on Thursday. Mendoza could get some reps with the starters on offense as well, as Kubiak also announced that they would play at least a portion of the game.
items.title: Fernando Mendoza to see "plenty" of playing time in preseason opener
